Terms & Conditions

Effective Date: August 2026

1. About Unigram

Unigram is an independent student-run platform built for students of Chaudhary Ranbir Singh University (CRSU), Jind. It is NOT officially affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to CRSU or any university authority. The university name is referenced only to identify the student community we serve.

2. Eligibility

Unigram is open to enrolled students of CRSU, Jind only. By creating an account, you confirm that you are a current student and that the details you provide (name, roll number, department, phone number) are accurate and belong to you.

3. Account Responsibilities

  • You are responsible for all activity that occurs under your account.
  • Do not share your login credentials with anyone.
  • Provide real, accurate information — fake or borrowed details will result in immediate account termination.
  • Notify us immediately at grievance@unigram.app if you suspect unauthorized access to your account.

4. Prohibited Content

The following content is strictly prohibited on Unigram:

  • Harassment, bullying, or personal attacks against any individual
  • Hate speech based on religion, caste, gender, ethnicity, or any protected characteristic
  • Defamatory statements about any person or institution
  • Explicit or sexual content involving real people
  • Doxxing — sharing private personal information of others without their consent
  • Illegal content of any kind
  • Impersonation of other students, faculty, or university officials
  • Spam or repetitive promotional content

5. Anonymous Posts

When you post to the Anonymous Feed, your identity is stored in our backend database, even though your name is hidden from other users in the UI. This is required for moderation and legal compliance under the IT Rules 2021.

If an anonymous post violates these Terms, administrators can identify the author and take appropriate action, including account suspension or reporting to relevant authorities. Anonymity is a UI feature, not a legal shield.

6. Intellectual Property

You retain all rights to the content you post on Unigram. By posting, you grant Unigram a non-exclusive, royalty-free license to display your content on the platform. We do not claim ownership over your content.

7. Platform Rights

  • We may suspend, restrict, or permanently ban accounts that violate these terms.
  • We may modify, discontinue, or add features without prior notice.
  • We do not guarantee uninterrupted uptime or availability of the platform.

8. Takedown Process (IT Rules 2021)

To report illegal or harmful content, email grievance@unigram.app with subject "Grievance: [Issue Type]". We acknowledge within 24 hours and take action within 36 hours as required under IT Rules 2021.

9. Disclaimer

Unigram is provided "as is" without any warranty. We are not responsible for user-generated content posted on the platform. We are not responsible for any loss, harm, or damage arising from your use of the platform.

10. Governing Law

These Terms are governed by the laws of India. Any disputes shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts at Jind, Haryana.
